subject.title: fix(google-vertex): add Google Vertex AI onboarding wizard, fix ADC auth, add provider docs

question: Should OpenClaw accept this PR's Google Vertex ADC setup contract: permissive auth evidence, request-time invalid-ADC failure, setup-written project/location/default model/marker, and manifest env-vars-with-marker evidence?
rationale: The patch appears coherent and well-scoped to the Google plugin boundary, but it changes provider auth/setup semantics and a plugin manifest surface rather than only repairing a local code defect.

options.title: Accept The ADC Setup Contract
options.body: Land this path as the intended Google Vertex onboarding contract, including permissive evidence, request-time credential validation, global/default-model writes, and marker auth profile.

options.title: Narrow Before Merge
options.body: Require stricter setup-time evidence or fewer setup-written defaults while preserving the proven Google Vertex onboarding flow.

options.title: Pause Behind The Vertex Cluster
options.body: Keep this PR as proof while issue #60736 and overlapping Vertex PRs settle the provider boundary first.

recommendation.title: Accept The ADC Setup Contract
recommendation.body: Land this path as the intended Google Vertex onboarding contract, including permissive evidence, request-time credential validation, global/default-model writes, and marker auth profile.

likelyOwner.reason: The most recent current-main blame for the affected auth/setup/provider-contract files points here, making this the best available routing owner for the contract decision.
